variant.author: Violet Stardust
variant.changelog:
# Version 1.6.0

- LootView now works with every game language: Japanese, German and French clients see their drops and rolls just like English ones.
- Need, Greed and Pass buttons on every open item in the roll window. Only the choices the game allows you are offered.
- The game's own Need/Greed window now stays hidden, so every roll happens in LootView. A button in the roll panel brings it back, and you can turn this off in Settings → Tracking.
- Items still waiting for your choice are listed first, newest on top.
- Hovering an item shows its full details: item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots, description and market price.
- Right-click an item to try it on, open it on Garland Tools or Universalis, or copy its name.
- Minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles and portrait frames show whether you already have them.
- LootView now has a Discord server: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ
